task.title: Implement pseudoterminal autoplay for single-path workflow transitions
task.description: Implement a pseudoterminal in the VSCode extension to intercept Claude Code output and detect [KANBAN_COMPLETE] markers. When detected and kanban.autoplay is enabled, automatically trigger the next workflow action for statuses with a single action path (e.g., planned to implement, in-progress to continue). Skip autoplay for statuses with multiple choices like codecheck and qa where the user must decide between approve/rework.
task.problem: The current terminal integration sends commands but does not process output. Users must manually trigger each workflow action after every skill completes, making the kanban workflow tedious for predictable transitions. This friction breaks flow and requires constant attention even when the next step is deterministic.
task.value: When kanban.autoplay is enabled and a skill completes with [KANBAN_COMPLETE], automatically trigger the next action for single-path statuses. This creates a seamless workflow experience where planned to implement to codecheck flows automatically, stopping only when user decision is needed. Users can start a workflow and let it run hands-free until human judgment is required.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a task is in a single-path status (planned, in-progress, update-docs) And kanban.autoplay setting is enabled When a skill completes and outputs [KANBAN_COMPLETE] Then the pseudoterminal detects the marker And waits 1-2 seconds for visibility And creates a fresh terminal (disposing the current one) And automatically triggers the next workflow action
Given a task is in a multi-choice status (codecheck, qa, pr) And kanban.autoplay setting is enabled When a skill completes and outputs [KANBAN_COMPLETE] Then autoplay does NOT trigger And the user must manually choose the next action
Given autoplay is running When the user closes the terminal Then autoplay stops and does not continue the chain
Given autoplay is running When the user disables kanban.autoplay setting Then autoplay stops after the current action completes
Given autoplay is enabled and running When transitions occur Then the status bar shows the current autoplay state and progress
